This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: pom.xml
- runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java
- single test target: src/test/java/MainTest.java
- test command: mvn -q test
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. Repeat this exact dependency contract in the pom.xml task.

Medium-size reference from MetaProjectDev (descriptive only; the architecture model's generated file count is authoritative):
- about 8 repository files
- about 30 functions or methods
- about 665 lines of code

Sizing guidance:
- #Files, #Functions, and #LOC above are paper-table references, not acceptance bounds
- use the number of files produced by this architecture run; do not add or remove files merely to hit the reference
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files when reporting the realized size

Required domain behavior:
- URL validation
- download request and format selection
- queue lifecycle
- progress and cancellation
- safe output naming
- offline deterministic transfer adapter for tests

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

Generate a complete medium-size Java 11 repository architecture for: Video Downloader.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: pom.xml
- runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java
- single test target: src/test/java/MainTest.java
- test command: mvn -q test
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. Repeat this exact dependency contract in the pom.xml task.

Medium-size reference from MetaProjectDev (descriptive only; the architecture model's generated file count is authoritative):
- about 8 repository files
- about 30 functions or methods
- about 665 lines of code

Sizing guidance:
- #Files, #Functions, and #LOC above are paper-table references, not acceptance bounds
- use the number of files produced by this architecture run; do not add or remove files merely to hit the reference
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files when reporting the realized size

Required domain behavior:
- URL validation
- download request and format selection
- queue lifecycle
- progress and cancellation
- safe output naming
- offline deterministic transfer adapter for tests

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java: public enum DownloadFormat { MP4, WEBM; public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext); public String defaultExtension(); } Semantics: fromExtension maps 'mp4' and 'webm' (case-insensitive) to respective enum constants; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown or null/empty ext. defaultExtension returns '.mp4' for MP4 and '.webm' for WEBM.

src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java: public final class ValidationUtils { public static boolean isValidUrl(String url); public static String sanitizeName(String name); public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format); } Semantics: isValidUrl returns true only for non-null URLs with scheme http or https, at least one '.', and no spaces; does not perform network I/O. sanitizeName trims, replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric ('a'-'z','A'-'Z','0'-'9'), dash, underscore, or dot with a single underscore, collapses spaces to underscores, and ensures non-empty result (returns 'download' if sanitized becomes empty). withExtension appends format.defaultExtension() to sanitized baseName, ensuring baseName does not already end with that extension; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.

src/main/java/VideoDownloadRequest.java: public final class VideoDownloadRequest { private final String url; private final DownloadFormat format; private final String suggestedName; private final String outputName; public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public String getUrl(); public DownloadFormat getFormat(); public String getSuggestedName(); public String getOutputName(); } Semantics: of validates inputs: url must pass ValidationUtils.isValidUrl; format and suggestedName must be non-null; outputName computed as ValidationUtils.withExtension(ValidationUtils.sanitizeName(suggestedName), format). Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid inputs. All getters return construction-time values.

src/main/java/DownloadStatus.java: public enum DownloadStatus { PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED; } Semantics: State machine statuses; transitions governed by DownloadTask as described below.

src/main/java/ProgressListener.java: public interface ProgressListener { void onProgress(long downloaded, long total); void onCompleted(); void onFailed(String message); } Semantics: callback boundaries; implementations must be non-blocking and avoid throwing exceptions.

src/main/java/TransferSession.java: public interface TransferSession { boolean step(); void cancel(); long getTotalBytes(); long getDownloadedBytes(); } Semantics: step advances exactly one deterministic transfer chunk, returns true if more steps remain after the step; returns false when no more steps; cancel stops the session and leaves it in a terminal state with downloaded <= total; total and downloaded are non-negative.

src/main/java/TransferAdapter.java: public interface TransferAdapter { TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin starts a new deterministic session. May throw IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments; must not perform network I/O in this project.

src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java: public final class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter { public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin validates non-null args and returns a deterministic TransferSession with: totalBytes = 1000; per-step increments of 100 until reaching totalBytes; on each step it invokes listener.onProgress(downloaded, total); when downloaded == total it invokes listener.onCompleted(); cancel() stops further step(); step() after completion returns false always; step() after cancel returns false; listener.onFailed is not used in this deterministic implementation. Guarantees headless, offline operation.

src/main/java/DownloadTask.java: public final class DownloadTask { private final int id; private final VideoDownloadRequest request; private DownloadStatus status; private TransferSession session; private int progress; public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request); public int getId(); public DownloadStatus getStatus(); public int getProgress(); public String getOutputName(); public void start(TransferAdapter adapter); public void tick(); public void cancel(); } Semantics: Constructor initializes status = PENDING, progress = 0. start(adapter) requires current status == PENDING; creates a ProgressListener that updates 'progress' as (int) Math.round(100.0 * downloaded / total) clamped 0..100, sets status to RUNNING, and wires session via adapter.begin(). tick(): if status == RUNNING and session != null, calls session.step(); recomputes progress; if session reports no more steps and progress == 100, sets status = COMPLETED; tick() when CANCELLED or COMPLETED or FAILED is a no-op. cancel(): if status is RUNNING or PENDING, cancels session (if non-null) and sets status to CANCELLED; idempotent if already terminal. Error behavior: IllegalStateException if start() called when not PENDING.

src/main/java/VideoDownloader.java: public final class VideoDownloader { private final TransferAdapter adapter; private final java.util.Map<Integer, DownloadTask> tasks; private int nextId; public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter); public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public void startPending(); public void tick(); public void cancel(int taskId); public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId); public int getProgress(int taskId); public String getOutputName(int taskId); } Semantics: Constructor requires non-null adapter. requestDownload creates VideoDownloadRequest.of and a new DownloadTask with id = nextId++, stores it, returns id. startPending starts all tasks with status PENDING. tick advances all RUNNING tasks by calling DownloadTask.tick(). cancel looks up task by id and calls task.cancel(); throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown. getStatus/getProgress/getOutputName return properties for existing tasks; each throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown.

src/main/java/Main.java: public final class Main { public static void main(String[] args); } Semantics: Demonstrates wiring by creating OfflineDeterministicAdapter and VideoDownloader, enqueuing two downloads, starting pending, ticking a few iterations, and printing status/progress; exits deterministically without long-running loops.

- Canonical public API: VideoDownloader orchestrates a queue of DownloadTask using a TransferAdapter. Validation and naming utilities are pure functions. Formats and statuses are enums. OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter and produces deterministic sessions.

Full API spec (all public types/functions, exact signatures and behavior):
- class DownloadFormat
  - public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext): Returns a supported format for a given extension (case-insensitive). Throws IllegalArgumentException for unsupported ext or null.

- class ValidationUtils
  - public static boolean isValidUrl(String url): Returns true for http/https URLs with host and optional path; rejects null/empty, spaces, invalid schemes, missing host.
  - public static String sanitizeName(String name): Returns a safe base name by stripping unsafe characters, trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and ensuring non-empty (falls back to "download").
  - public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format): Returns baseName + "." + format.defaultExtension(); baseName sanitized; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.
- class VideoDownloadRequest
  - public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates url/format; computes outputName via ValidationUtils; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.

  - public DownloadFormat getFormat(): Returns format.
  - public String getSuggestedName(): Returns original suggested name.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns sanitized name with extension; non-null.
- enum DownloadStatus: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.
- interface TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener): Starts a session; must be non-blocking; returns a session tracking total/downloaded bytes. Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments.
- interface TransferSession
  - public boolean step(): Advances transfer by one deterministic chunk; returns false when finished or cancelled; never blocks.
  - public void cancel(): Idempotent; stops future progress.
  - public long getTotalBytes(): Deterministic total bytes for this session.
  - public long getDownloadedBytes(): Bytes transferred so far.
- interface ProgressListener
  - public void onProgress(long downloaded, long total): Called after each step; must be lightweight and exception-free.
  - public void onCompleted(): Called exactly once when transfer reaches total.
  - public void onFailed(String message): Called on failure, with message; not used by offline adapter.
- class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(...): Produces deterministic total size based on URL string hash and fixed chunk size; steps accumulate until completed; calls listener callbacks.
- class DownloadTask
  - public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request): Constructs a task with PENDING status.
  - public int getId(): Returns task identifier.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(): Returns current status.
  - public int getProgress(): Returns percentage 0..100 based on session bytes; 0 for PENDING; 100 for COMPLETED.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns request.getOutputName().
  - public void start(TransferAdapter adapter): Transitions to RUNNING and attaches a session with listener updates.
  - public void tick(): If RUNNING, calls session.step() and updates status when completed.
  - public void cancel(): Cancels session if RUNNING and sets status to CANCELLED.
- class VideoDownloader (canonical API)
  - public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter): Requires non-null adapter.
  - public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates and enqueues; returns unique taskId; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.

src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java: public enum DownloadFormat { MP4, WEBM; public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext); public String defaultExtension(); } Semantics: fromExtension maps 'mp4' and 'webm' (case-insensitive) to respective enum constants; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown or null/empty ext. defaultExtension returns '.mp4' for MP4 and '.webm' for WEBM.

src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java: public final class ValidationUtils { public static boolean isValidUrl(String url); public static String sanitizeName(String name); public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format); } Semantics: isValidUrl returns true only for non-null URLs with scheme http or https, at least one '.', and no spaces; does not perform network I/O. sanitizeName trims, replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric ('a'-'z','A'-'Z','0'-'9'), dash, underscore, or dot with a single underscore, collapses spaces to underscores, and ensures non-empty result (returns 'download' if sanitized becomes empty). withExtension appends format.defaultExtension() to sanitized baseName, ensuring baseName does not already end with that extension; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.

src/main/java/VideoDownloadRequest.java: public final class VideoDownloadRequest { private final String url; private final DownloadFormat format; private final String suggestedName; private final String outputName; public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public String getUrl(); public DownloadFormat getFormat(); public String getSuggestedName(); public String getOutputName(); } Semantics: of validates inputs: url must pass ValidationUtils.isValidUrl; format and suggestedName must be non-null; outputName computed as ValidationUtils.withExtension(ValidationUtils.sanitizeName(suggestedName), format). Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid inputs. All getters return construction-time values.

src/main/java/DownloadStatus.java: public enum DownloadStatus { PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED; } Semantics: State machine statuses; transitions governed by DownloadTask as described below.

src/main/java/ProgressListener.java: public interface ProgressListener { void onProgress(long downloaded, long total); void onCompleted(); void onFailed(String message); } Semantics: callback boundaries; implementations must be non-blocking and avoid throwing exceptions.

src/main/java/TransferSession.java: public interface TransferSession { boolean step(); void cancel(); long getTotalBytes(); long getDownloadedBytes(); } Semantics: step advances exactly one deterministic transfer chunk, returns true if more steps remain after the step; returns false when no more steps; cancel stops the session and leaves it in a terminal state with downloaded <= total; total and downloaded are non-negative.

src/main/java/TransferAdapter.java: public interface TransferAdapter { TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin starts a new deterministic session. May throw IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments; must not perform network I/O in this project.

src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java: public final class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter { public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin validates non-null args and returns a deterministic TransferSession with: totalBytes = 1000; per-step increments of 100 until reaching totalBytes; on each step it invokes listener.onProgress(downloaded, total); when downloaded == total it invokes listener.onCompleted(); cancel() stops further step(); step() after completion returns false always; step() after cancel returns false; listener.onFailed is not used in this deterministic implementation. Guarantees headless, offline operation.

src/main/java/DownloadTask.java: public final class DownloadTask { private final int id; private final VideoDownloadRequest request; private DownloadStatus status; private TransferSession session; private int progress; public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request); public int getId(); public DownloadStatus getStatus(); public int getProgress(); public String getOutputName(); public void start(TransferAdapter adapter); public void tick(); public void cancel(); } Semantics: Constructor initializes status = PENDING, progress = 0. start(adapter) requires current status == PENDING; creates a ProgressListener that updates 'progress' as (int) Math.round(100.0 * downloaded / total) clamped 0..100, sets status to RUNNING, and wires session via adapter.begin(). tick(): if status == RUNNING and session != null, calls session.step(); recomputes progress; if session reports no more steps and progress == 100, sets status = COMPLETED; tick() when CANCELLED or COMPLETED or FAILED is a no-op. cancel(): if status is RUNNING or PENDING, cancels session (if non-null) and sets status to CANCELLED; idempotent if already terminal. Error behavior: IllegalStateException if start() called when not PENDING.

src/main/java/VideoDownloader.java: public final class VideoDownloader { private final TransferAdapter adapter; private final java.util.Map<Integer, DownloadTask> tasks; private int nextId; public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter); public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public void startPending(); public void tick(); public void cancel(int taskId); public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId); public int getProgress(int taskId); public String getOutputName(int taskId); } Semantics: Constructor requires non-null adapter. requestDownload creates VideoDownloadRequest.of and a new DownloadTask with id = nextId++, stores it, returns id. startPending starts all tasks with status PENDING. tick advances all RUNNING tasks by calling DownloadTask.tick(). cancel looks up task by id and calls task.cancel(); throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown. getStatus/getProgress/getOutputName return properties for existing tasks; each throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown.

src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java: public enum DownloadFormat { MP4, WEBM; public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext); public String defaultExtension(); } Semantics: fromExtension maps 'mp4' and 'webm' (case-insensitive) to respective enum constants; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown or null/empty ext. defaultExtension returns '.mp4' for MP4 and '.webm' for WEBM.

src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java: public final class ValidationUtils { public static boolean isValidUrl(String url); public static String sanitizeName(String name); public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format); } Semantics: isValidUrl returns true only for non-null URLs with scheme http or https, at least one '.', and no spaces; does not perform network I/O. sanitizeName trims, replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric ('a'-'z','A'-'Z','0'-'9'), dash, underscore, or dot with a single underscore, collapses spaces to underscores, and ensures non-empty result (returns 'download' if sanitized becomes empty). withExtension appends format.defaultExtension() to sanitized baseName, ensuring baseName does not already end with that extension; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.

src/main/java/VideoDownloadRequest.java: public final class VideoDownloadRequest { private final String url; private final DownloadFormat format; private final String suggestedName; private final String outputName; public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public String getUrl(); public DownloadFormat getFormat(); public String getSuggestedName(); public String getOutputName(); } Semantics: of validates inputs: url must pass ValidationUtils.isValidUrl; format and suggestedName must be non-null; outputName computed as ValidationUtils.withExtension(ValidationUtils.sanitizeName(suggestedName), format). Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid inputs. All getters return construction-time values.

src/main/java/DownloadStatus.java: public enum DownloadStatus { PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED; } Semantics: State machine statuses; transitions governed by DownloadTask as described below.

src/main/java/ProgressListener.java: public interface ProgressListener { void onProgress(long downloaded, long total); void onCompleted(); void onFailed(String message); } Semantics: callback boundaries; implementations must be non-blocking and avoid throwing exceptions.

src/main/java/TransferSession.java: public interface TransferSession { boolean step(); void cancel(); long getTotalBytes(); long getDownloadedBytes(); } Semantics: step advances exactly one deterministic transfer chunk, returns true if more steps remain after the step; returns false when no more steps; cancel stops the session and leaves it in a terminal state with downloaded <= total; total and downloaded are non-negative.

src/main/java/TransferAdapter.java: public interface TransferAdapter { TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin starts a new deterministic session. May throw IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments; must not perform network I/O in this project.

src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java: public final class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter { public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin validates non-null args and returns a deterministic TransferSession with: totalBytes = 1000; per-step increments of 100 until reaching totalBytes; on each step it invokes listener.onProgress(downloaded, total); when downloaded == total it invokes listener.onCompleted(); cancel() stops further step(); step() after completion returns false always; step() after cancel returns false; listener.onFailed is not used in this deterministic implementation. Guarantees headless, offline operation.

src/main/java/DownloadTask.java: public final class DownloadTask { private final int id; private final VideoDownloadRequest request; private DownloadStatus status; private TransferSession session; private int progress; public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request); public int getId(); public DownloadStatus getStatus(); public int getProgress(); public String getOutputName(); public void start(TransferAdapter adapter); public void tick(); public void cancel(); } Semantics: Constructor initializes status = PENDING, progress = 0. start(adapter) requires current status == PENDING; creates a ProgressListener that updates 'progress' as (int) Math.round(100.0 * downloaded / total) clamped 0..100, sets status to RUNNING, and wires session via adapter.begin(). tick(): if status == RUNNING and session != null, calls session.step(); recomputes progress; if session reports no more steps and progress == 100, sets status = COMPLETED; tick() when CANCELLED or COMPLETED or FAILED is a no-op. cancel(): if status is RUNNING or PENDING, cancels session (if non-null) and sets status to CANCELLED; idempotent if already terminal. Error behavior: IllegalStateException if start() called when not PENDING.

src/main/java/VideoDownloader.java: public final class VideoDownloader { private final TransferAdapter adapter; private final java.util.Map<Integer, DownloadTask> tasks; private int nextId; public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter); public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public void startPending(); public void tick(); public void cancel(int taskId); public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId); public int getProgress(int taskId); public String getOutputName(int taskId); } Semantics: Constructor requires non-null adapter. requestDownload creates VideoDownloadRequest.of and a new DownloadTask with id = nextId++, stores it, returns id. startPending starts all tasks with status PENDING. tick advances all RUNNING tasks by calling DownloadTask.tick(). cancel looks up task by id and calls task.cancel(); throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown. getStatus/getProgress/getOutputName return properties for existing tasks; each throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown.

src/main/java/Main.java: public final class Main { public static void main(String[] args); } Semantics: Demonstrates wiring by creating OfflineDeterministicAdapter and VideoDownloader, enqueuing two downloads, starting pending, ticking a few iterations, and printing status/progress; exits deterministically without long-running loops.

Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. - use the number of files produced by this architecture run; do not add or remove files merely to hit the reference

- queue lifecycle
- progress and cancellation
- safe output naming

- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

Architecture overview:
- Canonical public API: VideoDownloader orchestrates a queue of DownloadTask using a TransferAdapter. Validation and naming utilities are pure functions. Formats and statuses are enums. OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter and produces deterministic sessions.

Full API spec (all public types/functions, exact signatures and behavior):
- class DownloadFormat
  - public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext): Returns a supported format for a given extension (case-insensitive). Throws IllegalArgumentException for unsupported ext or null.
  - public String defaultExtension(): Returns canonical lowercase extension for the format (e.g., "mp4").
  - Supported enum constants: MP4, MP3, WEBM.
- class ValidationUtils
  - public static boolean isValidUrl(String url): Returns true for http/https URLs with host and optional path; rejects null/empty, spaces, invalid schemes, missing host.
  - public static String sanitizeName(String name): Returns a safe base name by stripping unsafe characters, trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and ensuring non-empty (falls back to "download").
  - public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format): Returns baseName + "." + format.defaultExtension(); baseName sanitized; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.
- class VideoDownloadRequest
  - public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates url/format; computes outputName via ValidationUtils; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public String getUrl(): Returns original URL.
  - public DownloadFormat getFormat(): Returns format.
  - public String getSuggestedName(): Returns original suggested name.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns sanitized name with extension; non-null.
- enum DownloadStatus: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.
- interface TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener): Starts a session; must be non-blocking; returns a session tracking total/downloaded bytes. Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments.
- interface TransferSession
  - public boolean step(): Advances transfer by one deterministic chunk; returns false when finished or cancelled; never blocks.
  - public void cancel(): Idempotent; stops future progress.
  - public long getTotalBytes(): Deterministic total bytes for this session.
  - public long getDownloadedBytes(): Bytes transferred so far.
- interface ProgressListener
  - public void onProgress(long downloaded, long total): Called after each step; must be lightweight and exception-free.
  - public void onCompleted(): Called exactly once when transfer reaches total.
  - public void onFailed(String message): Called on failure, with message; not used by offline adapter.
- class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(...): Produces deterministic total size based on URL string hash and fixed chunk size; steps accumulate until completed; calls listener callbacks.
- class DownloadTask
  - public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request): Constructs a task with PENDING status.
  - public int getId(): Returns task identifier.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(): Returns current status.
  - public int getProgress(): Returns percentage 0..100 based on session bytes; 0 for PENDING; 100 for COMPLETED.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns request.getOutputName().
  - public void start(TransferAdapter adapter): Transitions to RUNNING and attaches a session with listener updates.
  - public void tick(): If RUNNING, calls session.step() and updates status when completed.
  - public void cancel(): Cancels session if RUNNING and sets status to CANCELLED.
- class VideoDownloader (canonical API)
  - public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter): Requires non-null adapter.
  - public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates and enqueues; returns unique taskId; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public void startPending(): Starts all PENDING tasks; safe to call multiple times.
  - public void tick(): Advances all RUNNING tasks by one step; non-blocking.
  - public void cancel(int taskId): Cancels a task if RUNNING or PENDING; PENDING moves to CANCELLED without starting.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId): Returns status or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public int getProgress(int taskId): Returns progress percentage or 0 for PENDING; throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public String getOutputName(int taskId): Returns output name for the task or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.

Architecture overview:
- Canonical public API: VideoDownloader orchestrates a queue of DownloadTask using a TransferAdapter. Validation and naming utilities are pure functions. Formats and statuses are enums. OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter and produces deterministic sessions.
- Separation of concerns: Domain (requests, tasks, queue, sanitization) is separated from transfer boundary. No filesystem writes or real network.

Full API spec (all public types/functions, exact signatures and behavior):
- class DownloadFormat
  - public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext): Returns a supported format for a given extension (case-insensitive). Throws IllegalArgumentException for unsupported ext or null.
  - public String defaultExtension(): Returns canonical lowercase extension for the format (e.g., "mp4").
  - Supported enum constants: MP4, MP3, WEBM.
- class ValidationUtils
  - public static boolean isValidUrl(String url): Returns true for http/https URLs with host and optional path; rejects null/empty, spaces, invalid schemes, missing host.
  - public static String sanitizeName(String name): Returns a safe base name by stripping unsafe characters, trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and ensuring non-empty (falls back to "download").
  - public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format): Returns baseName + "." + format.defaultExtension(); baseName sanitized; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.
- class VideoDownloadRequest
  - public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates url/format; computes outputName via ValidationUtils; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public String getUrl(): Returns original URL.
  - public DownloadFormat getFormat(): Returns format.
  - public String getSuggestedName(): Returns original suggested name.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns sanitized name with extension; non-null.
- enum DownloadStatus: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.
- interface TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener): Starts a session; must be non-blocking; returns a session tracking total/downloaded bytes. Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments.
- interface TransferSession
  - public boolean step(): Advances transfer by one deterministic chunk; returns false when finished or cancelled; never blocks.
  - public void cancel(): Idempotent; stops future progress.
  - public long getTotalBytes(): Deterministic total bytes for this session.
  - public long getDownloadedBytes(): Bytes transferred so far.
- interface ProgressListener
  - public void onProgress(long downloaded, long total): Called after each step; must be lightweight and exception-free.
  - public void onCompleted(): Called exactly once when transfer reaches total.
  - public void onFailed(String message): Called on failure, with message; not used by offline adapter.
- class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(...): Produces deterministic total size based on URL string hash and fixed chunk size; steps accumulate until completed; calls listener callbacks.
- class DownloadTask
  - public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request): Constructs a task with PENDING status.
  - public int getId(): Returns task identifier.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(): Returns current status.
  - public int getProgress(): Returns percentage 0..100 based on session bytes; 0 for PENDING; 100 for COMPLETED.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns request.getOutputName().
  - public void start(TransferAdapter adapter): Transitions to RUNNING and attaches a session with listener updates.
  - public void tick(): If RUNNING, calls session.step() and updates status when completed.
  - public void cancel(): Cancels session if RUNNING and sets status to CANCELLED.
- class VideoDownloader (canonical API)
  - public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter): Requires non-null adapter.
  - public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates and enqueues; returns unique taskId; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public void startPending(): Starts all PENDING tasks; safe to call multiple times.
  - public void tick(): Advances all RUNNING tasks by one step; non-blocking.
  - public void cancel(int taskId): Cancels a task if RUNNING or PENDING; PENDING moves to CANCELLED without starting.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId): Returns status or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public int getProgress(int taskId): Returns progress percentage or 0 for PENDING; throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public String getOutputName(int taskId): Returns output name for the task or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.

- Implement sanitizeName(String) stripping unsafe characters, collapsing spaces to underscores, and fallback default.

4) DownloadStatus.java [Bob]
- Implement enum: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.

5) ProgressListener.java [Alex]
- Define interface with onProgress, onCompleted, onFailed methods.

6) TransferAdapter.java [Alex]

- Define interface step(), cancel(), getTotalBytes(), getDownloadedBytes() per API spec.

- Implement factory method of(url, format, name) validating via ValidationUtils and DownloadFormat.
- Store fields and compute outputName.
- Implement getters.

9) OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java [Bob]
- Implement TransferAdapter with nested OfflineDeterministicSession implementing TransferSession.
- Use deterministic total bytes from stable hash of URL: for example, compute SHA-1-like simple hash and map to range [50_000, 200_000].
- Use fixed chunk size (e.g., 4096 bytes) for step().
- Call ProgressListener appropriately, ensure no blocking and idempotent cancel.

- Maintain Map<Integer, DownloadTask> and monotonically increasing id counter.

- Implement tick() to advance RUNNING tasks.
- Implement cancel(int) and getters for status/progress/outputName; validate task existence.

Generate a complete medium-size Java 11 repository architecture for: Video Downloader.

This architecture will be implemented later by a seeded local code model and evaluated automatically. Produce concrete design and implementation tasks for every file; do not use placeholders.

Normative evaluator protocol (these paths are mandatory and override preferences):
- build file: pom.xml
- runtime entry: src/main/java/Main.java
- single test target: src/test/java/MainTest.java
- test command: mvn -q test
- keep exactly one protocol-level test file; additional non-test implementation files are allowed

Language/layout constraints:
Use Maven and Java 11 without preview features. Main.java must be in the default package because the evaluator runs Main. Put every other project class directly under src/main/java and keep it in the default package too; do not create package subdirectories or package declarations. This deliberately avoids package/import mismatches in independently generated files. Keep core logic independent from Swing/JavaFX; prefer no GUI and no non-test external dependency. pom.xml MUST declare org.junit.jupiter:junit-jupiter with test scope and a Maven Surefire version that runs JUnit 5; MainTest.java must use JUnit Jupiter only. Repeat this exact dependency contract in the pom.xml task.

Medium-size reference from MetaProjectDev (descriptive only; the architecture model's generated file count is authoritative):
- about 8 repository files
- about 30 functions or methods
- about 665 lines of code

Sizing guidance:
- #Files, #Functions, and #LOC above are paper-table references, not acceptance bounds
- use the number of files produced by this architecture run; do not add or remove files merely to hit the reference
- count build, runtime, test, package markers, headers, and implementation files when reporting the realized size

Required domain behavior:
- URL validation
- download request and format selection
- queue lifecycle
- progress and cancellation
- safe output naming
- offline deterministic transfer adapter for tests

Cross-cutting requirements:
- separate pure domain logic from runtime, UI, filesystem, network, clock, and randomness boundaries
- automated tests must be deterministic, headless, offline, and require no manual interaction
- keep the single test target concise (2 to 4 tests, preferably under 150 LOC): cover runtime wiring and representative core rules, not the full feature matrix
- do not inflate the function/LOC target with test code; put substantive behavior in implementation files
- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC
- order the Task list strictly by implementation dependency: foundational types and interfaces first, then dependent implementations, then the runtime entry, and the single test target LAST (the build descriptor may be first)
- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java: public enum DownloadFormat { MP4, WEBM; public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext); public String defaultExtension(); } Semantics: fromExtension maps 'mp4' and 'webm' (case-insensitive) to respective enum constants; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown or null/empty ext. defaultExtension returns '.mp4' for MP4 and '.webm' for WEBM.

src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java: public final class ValidationUtils { public static boolean isValidUrl(String url); public static String sanitizeName(String name); public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format); } Semantics: isValidUrl returns true only for non-null URLs with scheme http or https, at least one '.', and no spaces; does not perform network I/O. sanitizeName trims, replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric ('a'-'z','A'-'Z','0'-'9'), dash, underscore, or dot with a single underscore, collapses spaces to underscores, and ensures non-empty result (returns 'download' if sanitized becomes empty). withExtension appends format.defaultExtension() to sanitized baseName, ensuring baseName does not already end with that extension; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.

src/main/java/VideoDownloadRequest.java: public final class VideoDownloadRequest { private final String url; private final DownloadFormat format; private final String suggestedName; private final String outputName; public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public String getUrl(); public DownloadFormat getFormat(); public String getSuggestedName(); public String getOutputName(); } Semantics: of validates inputs: url must pass ValidationUtils.isValidUrl; format and suggestedName must be non-null; outputName computed as ValidationUtils.withExtension(ValidationUtils.sanitizeName(suggestedName), format). Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid inputs. All getters return construction-time values.

src/main/java/DownloadStatus.java: public enum DownloadStatus { PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED; } Semantics: State machine statuses; transitions governed by DownloadTask as described below.

src/main/java/ProgressListener.java: public interface ProgressListener { void onProgress(long downloaded, long total); void onCompleted(); void onFailed(String message); } Semantics: callback boundaries; implementations must be non-blocking and avoid throwing exceptions.

src/main/java/TransferSession.java: public interface TransferSession { boolean step(); void cancel(); long getTotalBytes(); long getDownloadedBytes(); } Semantics: step advances exactly one deterministic transfer chunk, returns true if more steps remain after the step; returns false when no more steps; cancel stops the session and leaves it in a terminal state with downloaded <= total; total and downloaded are non-negative.

src/main/java/TransferAdapter.java: public interface TransferAdapter { TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin starts a new deterministic session. May throw IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments; must not perform network I/O in this project.

src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java: public final class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter { public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin validates non-null args and returns a deterministic TransferSession with: totalBytes = 1000; per-step increments of 100 until reaching totalBytes; on each step it invokes listener.onProgress(downloaded, total); when downloaded == total it invokes listener.onCompleted(); cancel() stops further step(); step() after completion returns false always; step() after cancel returns false; listener.onFailed is not used in this deterministic implementation. Guarantees headless, offline operation.

src/main/java/DownloadTask.java: public final class DownloadTask { private final int id; private final VideoDownloadRequest request; private DownloadStatus status; private TransferSession session; private int progress; public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request); public int getId(); public DownloadStatus getStatus(); public int getProgress(); public String getOutputName(); public void start(TransferAdapter adapter); public void tick(); public void cancel(); } Semantics: Constructor initializes status = PENDING, progress = 0. start(adapter) requires current status == PENDING; creates a ProgressListener that updates 'progress' as (int) Math.round(100.0 * downloaded / total) clamped 0..100, sets status to RUNNING, and wires session via adapter.begin(). tick(): if status == RUNNING and session != null, calls session.step(); recomputes progress; if session reports no more steps and progress == 100, sets status = COMPLETED; tick() when CANCELLED or COMPLETED or FAILED is a no-op. cancel(): if status is RUNNING or PENDING, cancels session (if non-null) and sets status to CANCELLED; idempotent if already terminal. Error behavior: IllegalStateException if start() called when not PENDING.

src/main/java/VideoDownloader.java: public final class VideoDownloader { private final TransferAdapter adapter; private final java.util.Map<Integer, DownloadTask> tasks; private int nextId; public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter); public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName); public void startPending(); public void tick(); public void cancel(int taskId); public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId); public int getProgress(int taskId); public String getOutputName(int taskId); } Semantics: Constructor requires non-null adapter. requestDownload creates VideoDownloadRequest.of and a new DownloadTask with id = nextId++, stores it, returns id. startPending starts all tasks with status PENDING. tick advances all RUNNING tasks by calling DownloadTask.tick(). cancel looks up task by id and calls task.cancel(); throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown. getStatus/getProgress/getOutputName return properties for existing tasks; each throws IllegalArgumentException if id unknown.

src/main/java/Main.java: public final class Main { public static void main(String[] args); } Semantics: Demonstrates wiring by creating OfflineDeterministicAdapter and VideoDownloader, enqueuing two downloads, starting pending, ticking a few iterations, and printing status/progress; exits deterministically without long-running loops.

- Canonical public API: VideoDownloader orchestrates a queue of DownloadTask using a TransferAdapter. Validation and naming utilities are pure functions. Formats and statuses are enums. OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter and produces deterministic sessions.

Full API spec (all public types/functions, exact signatures and behavior):
- class DownloadFormat
  - public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext): Returns a supported format for a given extension (case-insensitive). Throws IllegalArgumentException for unsupported ext or null.

- class ValidationUtils

  - public static String sanitizeName(String name): Returns a safe base name by stripping unsafe characters, trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and ensuring non-empty (falls back to "download").
  - public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format): Returns baseName + "." + format.defaultExtension(); baseName sanitized; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.
- class VideoDownloadRequest
  - public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates url/format; computes outputName via ValidationUtils; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.

  - public DownloadFormat getFormat(): Returns format.
  - public String getSuggestedName(): Returns original suggested name.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns sanitized name with extension; non-null.
- enum DownloadStatus: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.
- interface TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener): Starts a session; must be non-blocking; returns a session tracking total/downloaded bytes. Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments.
- interface TransferSession
  - public boolean step(): Advances transfer by one deterministic chunk; returns false when finished or cancelled; never blocks.
  - public void cancel(): Idempotent; stops future progress.
  - public long getTotalBytes(): Deterministic total bytes for this session.
  - public long getDownloadedBytes(): Bytes transferred so far.
- interface ProgressListener
  - public void onProgress(long downloaded, long total): Called after each step; must be lightweight and exception-free.
  - public void onCompleted(): Called exactly once when transfer reaches total.
  - public void onFailed(String message): Called on failure, with message; not used by offline adapter.
- class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(...): Produces deterministic total size based on URL string hash and fixed chunk size; steps accumulate until completed; calls listener callbacks.
- class DownloadTask
  - public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request): Constructs a task with PENDING status.
  - public int getId(): Returns task identifier.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(): Returns current status.
  - public int getProgress(): Returns percentage 0..100 based on session bytes; 0 for PENDING; 100 for COMPLETED.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns request.getOutputName().
  - public void start(TransferAdapter adapter): Transitions to RUNNING and attaches a session with listener updates.
  - public void tick(): If RUNNING, calls session.step() and updates status when completed.
  - public void cancel(): Cancels session if RUNNING and sets status to CANCELLED.
- class VideoDownloader (canonical API)
  - public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter): Requires non-null adapter.
  - public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates and enqueues; returns unique taskId; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public void startPending(): Starts all PENDING tasks; safe to call multiple times.
  - public void tick(): Advances all RUNNING tasks by one step; non-blocking.
  - public void cancel(int taskId): Cancels a task if RUNNING or PENDING; PENDING moves to CANCELLED without starting.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId): Returns status or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public int getProgress(int taskId): Returns progress percentage or 0 for PENDING; throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public String getOutputName(int taskId): Returns output name for the task or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.

- Implement enum for MP4, MP3, WEBM.

- Validate input and throw IllegalArgumentException on unsupported values.

3) ValidationUtils.java [Eve]
- Implement isValidUrl(String) using URI parsing and scheme/host checks without network.
- Implement sanitizeName(String) stripping unsafe characters, collapsing spaces to underscores, and fallback default.
- Implement withExtension(String, DownloadFormat) combining sanitized name and canonical extension.

4) DownloadStatus.java [Bob]
- Implement enum: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.

5) ProgressListener.java [Alex]
- Define interface with onProgress, onCompleted, onFailed methods.

6) TransferAdapter.java [Alex]
- Define interface begin(String, DownloadFormat, String, ProgressListener) with argument validation expectations in doc comments.

7) TransferSession.java [Alex]
- Define interface step(), cancel(), getTotalBytes(), getDownloadedBytes() per API spec.

8) VideoDownloadRequest.java [Eve]
- Implement factory method of(url, format, name) validating via ValidationUtils and DownloadFormat.
- Store fields and compute outputName.
- Implement getters.

9) OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java [Bob]
- Implement TransferAdapter with nested OfflineDeterministicSession implementing TransferSession.
- Use deterministic total bytes from stable hash of URL: for example, compute SHA-1-like simple hash and map to range [50_000, 200_000].
- Use fixed chunk size (e.g., 4096 bytes) for step().
- Call ProgressListener appropriately, ensure no blocking and idempotent cancel.

10) DownloadTask.java [Eve]
- Implement task state, attaching session in start(TransferAdapter) with listener updating internal progress.
- Implement tick() to call session.step() and set COMPLETED when downloaded == total.
- Implement cancel() handling RUNNING and PENDING statuses.
- Expose getters id, status, progress, outputName.

11) VideoDownloader.java [Alex]
- Maintain Map<Integer, DownloadTask> and monotonically increasing id counter.
- Implement requestDownload() to create VideoDownloadRequest and task; return id.
- Implement startPending() to start all PENDING tasks using the adapter.
- Implement tick() to advance RUNNING tasks.
- Implement cancel(int) and getters for status/progress/outputName; validate task existence.

12) Main.java [Bob]
- Demonstrate: create OfflineDeterministicAdapter and VideoDownloader, enqueue two downloads, startPending, perform a few ticks, print statuses and progress, then exit.
- No loops beyond a small fixed number of ticks; handle exceptions.

- Avoid inspecting private internals; use canonical public API.

- make every planned file small enough for one 4096-token code completion: prefer under 150 LOC and never plan a file over 220 LOC

- the Engineer code_todos must preserve that dependency-first Task-list order so later files can see already-generated dependency code
- the runtime entry must provide a small non-interactive demonstration that exits successfully or starts safely without an output loop
- validate invalid inputs and boundary cases
- keep public interfaces coherent across design, task list, implementation, and tests
- specify one canonical public API; tests must use it without inventing alternate semantics
- make Full API spec non-empty and exhaustive: for every public type/function give its exact module, signature, return value, error behavior, and key semantics; repeat these exact contracts in each affected file task
- tests may import only the canonical public API and should assert stable externally visible behavior, not private implementation details, incidental formatting, or unplanned aliases
- avoid circular dependencies; explicitly give the allowed import/include direction and ensure every referenced symbol is defined before a dependent file is generated
- avoid network access and OS-specific behavior during build, tests, and runtime checks
- all planned source, header, build, and test files must be listed exactly and consistently in the design and task documents

- Canonical public API: VideoDownloader orchestrates a queue of DownloadTask using a TransferAdapter. Validation and naming utilities are pure functions. Formats and statuses are enums. OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter and produces deterministic sessions.
- Separation of concerns: Domain (requests, tasks, queue, sanitization) is separated from transfer boundary. No filesystem writes or real network.

Full API spec (all public types/functions, exact signatures and behavior):
- class DownloadFormat
  - public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext): Returns a supported format for a given extension (case-insensitive). Throws IllegalArgumentException for unsupported ext or null.
  - public String defaultExtension(): Returns canonical lowercase extension for the format (e.g., "mp4").
  - Supported enum constants: MP4, MP3, WEBM.
- class ValidationUtils
  - public static boolean isValidUrl(String url): Returns true for http/https URLs with host and optional path; rejects null/empty, spaces, invalid schemes, missing host.
  - public static String sanitizeName(String name): Returns a safe base name by stripping unsafe characters, trimming, replacing spaces with underscores, and ensuring non-empty (falls back to "download").
  - public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format): Returns baseName + "." + format.defaultExtension(); baseName sanitized; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.
- class VideoDownloadRequest
  - public static VideoDownloadRequest of(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates url/format; computes outputName via ValidationUtils; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public String getUrl(): Returns original URL.
  - public DownloadFormat getFormat(): Returns format.
  - public String getSuggestedName(): Returns original suggested name.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns sanitized name with extension; non-null.
- enum DownloadStatus: PENDING, RUNNING, COMPLETED, FAILED, CANCELLED.
- interface TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener): Starts a session; must be non-blocking; returns a session tracking total/downloaded bytes. Throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid arguments.
- interface TransferSession
  - public boolean step(): Advances transfer by one deterministic chunk; returns false when finished or cancelled; never blocks.
  - public void cancel(): Idempotent; stops future progress.
  - public long getTotalBytes(): Deterministic total bytes for this session.
  - public long getDownloadedBytes(): Bytes transferred so far.
- interface ProgressListener
  - public void onProgress(long downloaded, long total): Called after each step; must be lightweight and exception-free.
  - public void onCompleted(): Called exactly once when transfer reaches total.
  - public void onFailed(String message): Called on failure, with message; not used by offline adapter.
- class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter
  - public TransferSession begin(...): Produces deterministic total size based on URL string hash and fixed chunk size; steps accumulate until completed; calls listener callbacks.
- class DownloadTask
  - public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request): Constructs a task with PENDING status.
  - public int getId(): Returns task identifier.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(): Returns current status.
  - public int getProgress(): Returns percentage 0..100 based on session bytes; 0 for PENDING; 100 for COMPLETED.
  - public String getOutputName(): Returns request.getOutputName().
  - public void start(TransferAdapter adapter): Transitions to RUNNING and attaches a session with listener updates.
  - public void tick(): If RUNNING, calls session.step() and updates status when completed.
  - public void cancel(): Cancels session if RUNNING and sets status to CANCELLED.
- class VideoDownloader (canonical API)
  - public VideoDownloader(TransferAdapter adapter): Requires non-null adapter.
  - public int requestDownload(String url, DownloadFormat format, String suggestedName): Validates and enqueues; returns unique taskId; throws IllegalArgumentException on invalid input.
  - public void startPending(): Starts all PENDING tasks; safe to call multiple times.
  - public void tick(): Advances all RUNNING tasks by one step; non-blocking.
  - public void cancel(int taskId): Cancels a task if RUNNING or PENDING; PENDING moves to CANCELLED without starting.
  - public DownloadStatus getStatus(int taskId): Returns status or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public int getProgress(int taskId): Returns progress percentage or 0 for PENDING; throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.
  - public String getOutputName(int taskId): Returns output name for the task or throws IllegalArgumentException if not found.

- Implement tick() to advance RUNNING tasks.
- Implement cancel(int) and getters for status/progress/outputName; validate task existence.

- Demonstrate: create OfflineDeterministicAdapter and VideoDownloader, enqueue two downloads, startPending, perform a few ticks, print statuses and progress, then exit.

- Avoid inspecting private internals; use canonical public API.

src/main/java/DownloadFormat.java: public enum DownloadFormat { MP4, WEBM; public static DownloadFormat fromExtension(String ext); public String defaultExtension(); } Semantics: fromExtension maps 'mp4' and 'webm' (case-insensitive) to respective enum constants; throws IllegalArgumentException for unknown or null/empty ext. defaultExtension returns '.mp4' for MP4 and '.webm' for WEBM.

src/main/java/ValidationUtils.java: public final class ValidationUtils { public static boolean isValidUrl(String url); public static String sanitizeName(String name); public static String withExtension(String baseName, DownloadFormat format); } Semantics: isValidUrl returns true only for non-null URLs with scheme http or https, at least one '.', and no spaces; does not perform network I/O. sanitizeName trims, replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric ('a'-'z','A'-'Z','0'-'9'), dash, underscore, or dot with a single underscore, collapses spaces to underscores, and ensures non-empty result (returns 'download' if sanitized becomes empty). withExtension appends format.defaultExtension() to sanitized baseName, ensuring baseName does not already end with that extension; throws IllegalArgumentException if format is null.

src/main/java/OfflineDeterministicAdapter.java: public final class OfflineDeterministicAdapter implements TransferAdapter { public TransferSession begin(String url, DownloadFormat format, String outputName, ProgressListener listener); } Semantics: begin validates non-null args and returns a deterministic TransferSession with: totalBytes = 1000; per-step increments of 100 until reaching totalBytes; on each step it invokes listener.onProgress(downloaded, total); when downloaded == total it invokes listener.onCompleted(); cancel() stops further step(); step() after completion returns false always; step() after cancel returns false; listener.onFailed is not used in this deterministic implementation. Guarantees headless, offline operation.

src/main/java/DownloadTask.java: public final class DownloadTask { private final int id; private final VideoDownloadRequest request; private DownloadStatus status; private TransferSession session; private int progress; public DownloadTask(int id, VideoDownloadRequest request); public int getId(); public DownloadStatus getStatus(); public int getProgress(); public String getOutputName(); public void start(TransferAdapter adapter); public void tick(); public void cancel(); } Semantics: Constructor initializes status = PENDING, progress = 0. start(adapter) requires current status == PENDING; creates a ProgressListener that updates 'progress' as (int) Math.round(100.0 * downloaded / total) clamped 0..100, sets status to RUNNING, and wires session via adapter.begin(). tick(): if status == RUNNING and session != null, calls session.step(); recomputes progress; if session reports no more steps and progress == 100, sets status = COMPLETED; tick() when CANCELLED or COMPLETED or FAILED is a no-op. cancel(): if status is RUNNING or PENDING, cancels session (if non-null) and sets status to CANCELLED; idempotent if already terminal.
